story.overview: As a user interacting with Orion, I want clean, professional status messages during tool execution and filtered code output, so that I never see raw Python imports, stack traces, or technical noise in Orion's responses.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: No Code Leakage - Python import statements, stack traces, and raw code NEVER shown to users. - Import statements (single-line and multi-line) are filtered - Stack traces replaced with placeholder text - REPL artifacts (>>> , ... ) stripped from output

Filtered Sandbox Output - stdout/stderr from code execution is sanitized before display. - Debug statements (DEBUG:, [DEBUG], VERBOSE:) filtered - File path references (File "/app/script.py") removed - Excessive whitespace normalized (multiple blank lines collapsed)

Consistent Summary Format - All tool calls use standardized format. - Format: {Action Verb} {Tool Name} - "{context}" - Action verbs: Searching, Calling, Executing, Analyzing, Generating, Fetching - Context truncated at 40 chars with ellipsis if needed

User-Friendly Errors - Technical sandbox errors converted to helpful messages. - Python error types mapped to friendly messages - JS/Node error codes (ECONNREFUSED, ETIMEDOUT) humanized - Technical details preserved for logging, user sees friendly text

Status Message Guidelines - Standard patterns documented in project-context.md. - Forbidden content list: imports, stack traces, debug output, REPL artifacts - Module usage examples for formatToolSummary, sanitizeCodeOutput, humanizeError

Test Coverage - Unit tests verify filtering works for common leak scenarios. - Tests for import filtering (single-line, multi-line, from...import) - Tests for stack trace detection and filtering - Tests for error humanization mapping

files.file: Updated with Tool Status Message Guidelines section

output-sanitization-pipeline.step: Traceback detection - Detects "Traceback (most recent call last):" and filters entire block
Import filtering - Removes single-line (import x) and multi-line (from x import (...)) imports
REPL artifact removal - Strips ">>> " and "... " prompts, preserving content after
Stack trace filtering - Removes File "..." and "at line N" patterns
Debug statement filtering - Removes DEBUG:, [DEBUG], VERBOSE: prefixed lines
Whitespace normalization - Collapses multiple blank lines into single blank line

relevant-sections.section: Story 8.5 is part of Epic 8 focusing on Anthropic API enhancements for response quality and scalability.
Tool utilities follow Tier 1 enforced patterns via TypeScript types. All modules use ToolResult pattern for consistent error handling.
New tools follow established structure under src/tools/ with co-located tests.

patterns-to-follow.pattern: Return ToolResult type from handlers, never throw from tool handlers.
Place *.test.ts files next to implementation files.
Use .js extension for relative imports in TypeScript.
Export TypeScript interfaces for all public APIs.
Internal errors (logged) -> ToolError (to Claude) -> UserError (to Slack)
